test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 29 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code, if 15 - 20 - 17 - 2 - 7 - 0 - 18 - 5 denotes PURCHASE and 14 - 17 - 3 - 4 - 18 denotes ORDER, then what does 15 - 17 - 14 - 2 - 4 - 18 - 19 denote ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

15 - 20 - 17 - 2 - 7 - 0 - 18 - 5 denotes PURCHASE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13314fc38775d6d9416e90e05253684d40f1dd1d88df6c7132aca34a8ab4c979.png] 

And,

14 - 17 - 3 - 4 - 18 denotes ORDER

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3939f2535d6b45caebb026c09eb4540cc35a4e5f86b61f86407e9c5d10597999.png] 

Similarly,

15 - 17 - 14 - 2 - 4 - 18 - 19 denotes

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e5a79d840d0472bc7d7760fffe8c5a07339ef356d1d7078dace77652d755125.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
